pages.name: English Opening: King's English Variation, Four Knights Variation, Fianchetto Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 named Nd2 (ambiguous) and plan 2 rerouted a knight from b8, where none stands; overview called it symmetrical. Rewrote overview and both plans around the reversed Dragon.

pages.name: English Opening: King's English Variation, Four Knights Variation, Fianchetto Line, with Nb6
pages.notes: Plan 1 called the c-file open; plan 2 read b4 as a Black move. Narrow rewrites; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Four Knights, 4.g3 Bb4 5.Bg2
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 described a pin on the c3-knight, which the d2-pawn blocks; plan 1 pushed b4 onto the bishop. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2 around ...O-O, ...e4 and ...Bxc3. A new plan 3 was rejected twice (first ...d6 does not support e4, then it named an e4-pawn before ...e4), so plan 3 keeps its old text with British spelling only.

pages.name: English: Four Knights, 4.g3 Bc5
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed Nf3-e1 with the king on e1 and ...Nf6-e8-g7 with a pawn on g7. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Four Knights, 4.g3 Bc5
pages.notes: Plan 2 read Ng5 as a Black move; overview called the position symmetrical. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Four Knights, 4.g3 d5
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Nb6 challenging a c4-pawn that is exchanged on d5. Rewrote overview and plan 2 around the reversed Dragon.

pages.name: English: Four Knights, 4.g3 d5 5.cxd5
pages.notes: Plan 2 proposed ...Nb6-c4 and omitted the recapture; plan 4 was a vague endgame line. Rewrote overview and plans 1-4.

pages.name: English: Four Knights, 4.g3 d5 5.cxd5 Nxd5 6.Bg2 Be6
pages.notes: Plan 2 broke a pin that does not exist; plan 3 played ...Re8 before castling; plan 4 claimed ...Nxc3 doubles White's pawns (the c-pawn is already gone). Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Four Knights, 4.g3 d5 5.cxd5 Nxd5 6.Bg2 Nb6 7.O-O Be7 8.d3
pages.notes: Plan 3 read d5 as a Black pawn move; plan 4 was a vague endgame line; overview called it symmetrical. Rewrote overview and plans 3-4.

pages.name: English: Four Knights, 4.g3 d5 5.cxd5 Nxd5 6.Bg2 Nb6 7.O-O Be7 8.d3
pages.notes: Plan 2 'fixed' a b4-pawn that is not there; plan 4 rerouted a non-existent f6-knight. Rewrote overview and plans 2 and 4; British spelling.
